title: Regional circuit orchestration: SLI propagation and progressive shed dashboard
creator: Samira Patel
description: Build an operational dashboard and supporting instrumentation to visualize how regional circuit orchestration decisions (circuit open/close, progressive shedding, fallback routing) propagate SLI signals across regions and affect token-level latency and cost. This ticket combines telemetry queries, dashboard panels, runbook hooks, and a lightweight API contract so downstream tooling (routing/orchestration) can surface decision signals to SREs and product owners. Goal: reduce mean time to detect/regress SLO violations caused by cross-region failovers and make shedding behavior explainable at token granularity.
acceptance_criteria: A single Grafana dashboard exists that shows per-region golden signals and derived token-level latency SLIs correlated with circuit state changes
Telemetry queries return token-p50/p90/p99 for generation and embed requests segmented by region, model variant, and circuit state within 2s for 1m intervals
A short-lived log/metric tag is emitted when orchestration changes circuit state (reason, triggered_by, affected_pool) and appears as a panel filter
SLO breach drill: trigger simulated region failure; dashboard shows fallback activation, circuit opens, shedding rate, and downstream increase in token latency. Post-mortem checklist auto-linked
Runbook additions and playbook steps added to Confluence with links from the dashboard
tasks: Add new metric: orchestration.circuit_state_change{region, pool, reason, by} (counter with last_seen timestamp)
Expose circuit_state label in request logs and in metrics pipeline for correlation
Instrument token-level latency SLI export for v2 generation API (token_latency_ms histogram buckets at 1/5/10/20/50/100/250/500/1000)
Build Grafana dashboard with panels described below and ensure template variables for region/model/circuit_state
Create a lightweight API contract in docs (confluence) so routing can emit decision events
Add canary tests that validate metric emission and panel coverage on staging prior to rollout
progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting — aligned with runtime and routing teams. Decision: use existing metrics pipeline (Prometheus + Pushgateway) for first pass
2026-02-20: Drafted metric schema in Confluence (link below). Runtime team to add token_latency_ms histogram and orchestration event counter
2026-02-28: Instrumentation PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4126 — token latency histograms added for gen v2 endpoint (pending review)
2026-03-05: First Grafana prototype created in staging (grafana.org/d/abc123/regional-orchestration-proto) — shows region p90 regressions but missing circuit_state tagging
2026-03-09: Routing team added circuit_state emit in staging: orch.change events are now visible as metric labels. Dashboard updated to filter by last_seen
decisions: We will record circuit orchestration events as a counter metric instead of pure logs to simplify correlation with Prometheus histograms
Token-level SLI will be derived from per-request histograms emitted by runtime; we will avoid sampling at this stage to get accurate tail behavior
Dashboard will default to showing active circuits in the last 10 minutes, with an option to zoom to a specific failover window
Progressive shedding percentages will be emitted as gauge metrics by the router so shedding rate can be plotted against token latency in the same time series view
telemetry_queries: Prometheus: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket[2m])) by (le, region, model, circuit_state))
Derived SLI: increase(token_errors_total{region}[5m]) / increase(requests_total{region}[5m]) — used to compute error budget burn per-region
dashboard_panels: Overview row: active circuit state map (region) + last orchestration change with 'reason' and 'by' fields
Golden signals row: per-region request rate, error rate, saturation (GPU util) and latency p50/p90/p99 — templated by model and pool
Token SLI row: token_latency p50/p90/p99 histograms by region and circuit_state with anomaly shading when SLO thresholds crossed
Shedding and fallback correlation: panel plotting progressive_shed_percentage, fallback_rate, and token p90 on a shared axis
Event timeline: orchestration.change counter spikes annotated on top of latency heatmap for quick root-cause correlation
Cost impact panel: tokens_served_by_fallback / total_tokens over time and estimated delta in GPU seconds
Playbook quick links: runbook actions (failback, increase capacity, tighten shedding) pinned in dashboard header
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (staging): validate metric schema and dashboard rendering with synthetic failover — deadline 2026-03-08
Stage 2 (canary in production): enable metrics + dashboard for 10% of traffic in us-west-2 and eu-central-1, monitor for 48h
Stage 3 (full): enable across regions, update runbooks and notify on-call SREs
Rollback: remove orchestration metric emission or revert dashboard alerts if metric cardinality causes ingestion issues
qa_notes: Ensure histogram buckets include sub-millisecond buckets for token generation when using short prompt lengths
Validate label cardinality: region, model, pool, circuit_state, reason — do not add high-cardinality freeform labels
Run synthetic load test that triggers progressive shedding (use routing test harness) and confirm events appear in dashboard within 30s
Check Prometheus scrape and Pushgateway retention to avoid high ingestion cost; set relabel rules if necessary
followups: Automate SLO alert correlation: create an alert that links a triggered SLO breach to the last orchestration.change events in the 15m window
Add cost-aware recommendations to console: when shedding increases, surface estimated cost saved vs. user impact
Investigate exporting orchestration events to tracing system so distributed traces can be correlated with circuit changes
Post-rollout retrospective and update the incident playbook with concrete thresholds observed in real traffic
